headline: Sobha reports Q2 sales value at ₹2,206 crore, up 16% year-on-year
hook: Strong yearly growth despite a sequential dip
summary: Bengaluru-based real estate developer Sobha posted a total sales value of ₹2,206 crore for the second quarter, marking a 16% increase compared to the same period last year. However, performance slowed on a sequential basis, with total sales value declining 40% and sales area dropping 39.3% from the previous quarter. Total sales area for the quarter rose marginally by 2.2% year-on-year to 1.34 million square feet. For Indian retail investors, real estate updates signal demand trends in the housing sector and directly impact the valuation of listed realty peers.
